title: ranunculus acidotus
intro: Ranunculus acidotus, commonly known as Yellow Ranunculus, is a type of flowering plant in the Ranunculaceae family. The plant is said to have various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve immune function. Its therapeutic actions include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus acidotus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
